question: How extensive is the variation of sacred places taught in the scriptures?
premises: The difference of sacred places is varied.
In scripture this variation is beyond counting.
The Vīrāvalihṛdaya specifically mentions seven places and a pair of śakti-lotuses.
inference: Although scriptural teaching presents countless variations of sacred places, some texts give specific enumerations.
uncertainties: The final token śaktikamalayugam may be part of the enumerated list in a way not fully explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: The difference of sacred places is varied and, in scripture, beyond counting. In the Vīrāvalihṛdaya, seven places are mentioned, along with a pair of śakti-lotuses.
